utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? I was thinking of helping out.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, yeah? That sounds great! I might be a bit late, but count me in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Awesome, I'll let the organizers know you're coming. What time do you think you'll make it?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any tools?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, yes. Do you have any screwdrivers or wrenches?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I've got a full set. I'll bring them Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Need me to check what supplies we've got left for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Huh? The repair drive? Oh, right, that's today?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, it's today! I've got the inventory list ready—want me to run through what we have?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Pia, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, hi Rey! I'm glad you asked. We need to coordinate the tools and supplies, maybe you could help make a list of what everyone's bringing?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Do you have a list of what's already been offered?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What kind of repairs are we doing, and when?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not sure about all the details, but I heard we're doing some basic home maintenance next Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do you know what time we're starting on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Gus, have you heard about the upcoming repair drive? They're fixing up old appliances for free next Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A repair drive, huh? That sounds great! I've got some tools I could lend if needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that's wonderful, Gus! They'll probably appreciate those tools. I'll let the organizers know you're offering.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Opal, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend? We need all hands on deck!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: A repair drive? Where's it being held? I need to mark it on my map.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Elm Street, starting at 9 AM. I'll be there, hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Kira, I heard you're working on a repair drive. Need any help with that?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: What repair drive are you talking about?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, I thought I saw you with some old hard drives from the community center. Maybe I got mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo! I'm so glad you're here to talk about the repair drive. I've been mapping out the neighborhood's needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, a repair drive? Sounds great, I'll help where I can. Just let me know what to do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's wonderful! Do you have any particular skills or tools you can bring to the table? I'm trying to match volunteers with specific tasks.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Eli, I heard we're organizing a repair drive this weekend. Are you planning to come?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I'd like to join, but what time does it start? I like to have my schedule set ahead.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm not sure about the exact time, but I heard it's in the morning. I'll find out and get back to you!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hi Uli! Were we talking about the repair drive? I think I need to pick up some supplies, but I can't remember what I needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I... I'm not sure. I've been a bit distracted lately.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You too, huh? I keep forgetting things these days. Maybe we can figure it out together.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? I heard they could use some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, yeah, I might be able to stop by for a bit on Saturday morning. What needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: They're focusing on the community center's playground equipment and some garden beds. Do you have any handy skills like carpentry or gardening?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane! Have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, a repair drive? I haven't heard about it yet. What's that all about?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's a great event where neighbors help each other fix things like broken chairs, leaky faucets, or small electronics. You should come by!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It's a community event where folks help each other fix up their homes. I'm organizing the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds nice. Do you need any help with the schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, have you heard about the repair drive? I was thinking it might affect the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I haven't heard about that yet. Do you think it could cause delays? I've got to pick up my kids at 3.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I heard the repair drive might close the main road near the school from 2 to 4. We might need to arrange alternate pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Vik, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help rounding up volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm planning a repair drive for this Saturday! I could definitely use some help spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I'll ask around my groups and see who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Pia, I heard about the repair drive. I've got a bunch of tools if anyone needs to borrow them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks Gus, but do we have a system for who gets what and when they'll be returned?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Good point. I'll make a sign-out sheet so we can track them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rosa, I heard there's a repair drive happening. Do you know which areas are being prioritized?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We're starting with the east side of the block, especially Elm Street, since those homes were hit hardest by the storm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good to know. Do you have a timeline for when they'll move to other streets?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean? The one for the community center?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes, that's the one. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I heard you're organizing a repair drive. Need any help?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sam, that's so kind of you! I could definitely use a hand sorting through the donated tools and materials.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I'm free this afternoon. Want me to come by?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Noah, what's this repair drive I've been hearing about?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Repair drive? Hmm, I think I saw a flyer about that... maybe?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Could you check what the flyer said? I'm curious about it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, you're sure this repair drive is legit? I've heard some shady stories about neighborhood drives.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I promise it's legit! I've already seen Mrs. Henderson from two streets over drop off her toaster, and she said they fixed it in a day.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Mrs. Henderson? She'd be impressed by a paperclip if it sparkled. You got anyone else vouching for this?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, how's the repair drive coming along? I heard there might be some progress.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's... fine. I've been taking it one day at a time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm glad to hear you're managing. Anything specific you've been working on?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Leo! What's this about a repair drive again? I'm sorry, my memory isn't what it used to be.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's a community event where we fix broken items together. Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the repair drive! I'll try to remember that. What time Saturday?
